Scale: the plate is square-ish and about 24 cm across, so I treated it as a dinner plate slightly smaller than 26 cm.

Scrambled eggs cover roughly 7 cm by 9 cm, with a height of about 2 cm. That is about 60 cm² of footprint, or roughly 80-100 cm³ of loosely packed eggs. At about 0.6 g/cm³ this comes to about 60 g.

The bacon is a single strip, curled, about 15 cm long and 1.5 cm wide. It looks like one cooked slice, so about 8 g.
